svg.title: Internals of a single multi-head attention call: input, projection, head split
svg.desc: Shows how one attention call produces 3 input tensors, 3 projected tensors, and 3 times num_heads per-head views.
svg.text: Stage A. Inputs to the attention call (3 tensors)
These are the args passed to forward(Q, K, V, mask). Each is full embed_dim.
Stage B. After Q/K/V projection (3 tensors)
Each input passes through its own nn.Linear(512 → 512). Same shape, different content.
Stage C. After splitting into heads (3 tensors, but with a head dimension)
No new tensors are created — the 512 dim is just sliced into 8 chunks of 64.

g.text: Per attention call: 3 input tensors → 3 projected → 3 head-split (each viewed as 8 per-head slices)
Total distinct tensors stored in memory: ~6. Logical per-head Q/K/V: 24 (8 heads × 3 roles).
